checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Presenter remains recognizably the grey-haired man
must.why: Same face, hair, shirt and kitchen across all frames.

must.item: Audible coherent agent-written English line inviting viewers to the sale
must.why: Script in the reply is fitting, but audio was not heard.

must.item: No invented discount, date, product, or offer
must.why: Script says only 'sale right now', 'save big'; no specifics.

must.item: Mouth visibly moves in sync with speech
must.why: Mouth open mid-speech at 3.2s and 5.6s, closed at start and end; sync itself cannot be verified from stills.

must.item: One square 8s video, friendly male voice, no captions
must.why: Frames are square, 8s, with no captions; voice friendliness cannot be heard but the pick is an upbeat male voice.

faults.what: Script of about 25 words in 8 seconds may be rushed or end early; the final frame shows a closed mouth, so there may be trailing silence.
Stock voice, not the user's own voice, so it may not match his face; the reply disclosed this.

summary: A clean, square 8-second talking video where the grey-haired man keeps his identity and his mouth moves naturally, with a generic upbeat sale script and a stock voice that I could not hear.
